# World properties

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from src/sim/properties/spec.ts; do not edit. -->

The closed, versioned world-property vocabulary (version 2).
Interactions come from these properties, never from pairs of object types, so spells, arrows,
tools, AI and level data all use exactly these camelCase keys. A property an entity lacks reads
its default. Data files set them under `properties` (src/content/world-properties.ts); material
presets set the material-level ones ([materials](materials.md)). Adding or changing a property
bumps `WORLD_PROPERTIES_VERSION` and the contract test tests/contracts/world-properties.test.ts.
Threshold properties (`fragile`, `unstable`, `shootable`, `chargeActivated`, `lightActivated`)
default to their maximum, which nothing reaches: absent means "never triggers".

| Property | Type | Values | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bashable` | flag | true, false | false | A shield bash or kick shoves it (or breaks it when breakable). |
| `breakable` | flag | true, false | false | A single hit at or above its toughness for that kind of hit breaks it. |
| `burning` | flag | true, false | false | On fire right now. |
| `charge` | number | 0–1,000,000 charge | 0 | Stored electric charge. |
| `chargeActivated` | number | 0–1,000,000,000 charge | 1,000,000,000 | Stored charge at which the mechanism fires. |
| `climbable` | number | whole 1–3 grade | 1 | Climbing grade: 1 easy, 2 needs stamina, 3 needs skill or a tool. |
| `conductive` | flag | true, false | false | Conducts electric charge. |
| `container` | flag | true, false | false | Holds items (contents live in the e18 container component). |
| `cuttable` | flag | true, false | false | Slash or pierce damage severs it. |
| `density` | number | 0.01–100,000 kg/m³ | 1,000 | Density; below 1000 it floats in water. |
| `extinguishable` | flag | true, false | false | A fire or light source that water, force or an interaction puts out. |
| `flammable` | flag | true, false | false | Fire can ignite it. |
| `flammableGas` | flag | true, false | false | A gas that ignites (flares or explodes) when fire reaches it. |
| `fragile` | number | 0–1,000,000,000 J | 1,000,000,000 | Impact energy of any kind that breaks it (the default is effectively unbreakable). |
| `freezePoint` | number | -273.15–10,000 °C | 0 | Temperature at or below which it freezes. |
| `friction` | number | 0–2 | 0.6 | Surface friction coefficient. |
| `frozen` | flag | true, false | false | Frozen solid. |
| `fuel` | number | 0–86,400 s | 0 | Seconds of burning left. |
| `hidden` | flag | true, false | false | Not perceivable or targetable until revealed. |
| `hideable` | flag | true, false | false | An actor can hide in or behind it. |
| `hp` | number | 0–1,000,000 hp | 100 | Structural hit points. |
| `ignitionPoint` | number | -273.15–10,000 °C | 300 | Temperature at which it ignites. |
| `impactAbsorb` | number | 0–1 | 0 | Fraction of impact energy it absorbs. |
| `liftable` | flag | true, false | false | Can be picked up and carried. |
| `lightActivated` | number | 0–1,000,000,000 light | 1,000,000,000 | Light level on it at which the mechanism fires. |
| `lightEmitter` | record | `intensity` 0–100,000 light; `radius` 0–100 m | `{"intensity":0,"radius":0}` | Emits light of this intensity out to this radius. |
| `liquid` | flag | true, false | false | A liquid: it pours, puddles and can have a water surface. |
| `material` | id | kebab-case id | generic | Material preset id. |
| `noiseMultiplier` | number | 0.2–3 × | 1 | Multiplier on its wearer's noise; an actor's is the product of its equipment's. |
| `opaque` | flag | true, false | false | Fully blocks light and sight. |
| `owner` | id | kebab-case id | unowned | Ownership tag (faction or owner id). |
| `pushable` | flag | true, false | false | Can be pushed or dragged. |
| `reflective` | flag | true, false | false | Mirror-like: light beams and bolts bounce off it by the surface normal. |
| `remains` | flag | true, false | false | Inert skeletal or corpse remains that summoning can raise. |
| `shootable` | number | 0–1,000,000 N·s | 1,000,000 | Projectile impulse that fires its signal. |
| `softAnchor` | flag | true, false | false | Rope arrows and hooks embed in it. |
| `soundDamping` | number | 0–1 | 0 | Fraction of sound it absorbs. |
| `support` | number | whole 0–9,007,199,254,740,991 entity | 0 | Entity a suspended object hangs from (0 = none). |
| `surfaceHardness` | one of | `soft`, `medium`, `hard` | medium | Footstep loudness and whether arrows stick (soft, medium) or ricochet (hard). |
| `suspended` | flag | true, false | false | Hangs from its support; falls when the support breaks, burns or is cut. |
| `temperature` | number | -273.15–10,000 °C | 20 | Current temperature. |
| `toughness` | record (any fields) | `blunt` 0–1,000,000,000 J; `slash` 0–1,000,000,000 J; `pierce` 0–1,000,000,000 J; `force` 0–1,000,000,000 J | `{}` | Single-hit energy per kind of hit that breaks a breakable object (a kind left out never does). |
| `transparent` | flag | true, false | false | Light and sight pass through it. |
| `trap` | id | kebab-case id | none | Trap definition a trapped object triggers. |
| `trapped` | flag | true, false | false | Interacting with it triggers its trap unless disarmed first. |
| `unstable` | number | 0–1,000,000,000 J | 1,000,000,000 | Force of one push, blast or quake that topples it. |
| `waterSurface` | flag | true, false | false | Top surface of a body of liquid: cold freezes it into walkable ice. |
| `weight` | number | 0–1,000,000 kg | 1 | Mass. |
| `wetness` | number | 0–1 | 0 | How soaked it is (0 dry, 1 saturated). |

## Rejected spellings

Data using another spelling of a key (`soft_anchor`, `water-surface`, `Flammable-Gas`: any key
equal to a canonical one ignoring case, `-` and `_`) or one of these synonyms fails validation
with a message naming the canonical key.

| Written | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `wet` | `wetness` |
| `brittle` | `fragile` |
| `buoyant` | `density` |
| `mass` | `weight` |
| `movable` | `pushable` |
| `slippery` | `friction` |
| `hardness` | `surfaceHardness` |
| `electrified` | `charge` |

## Not world properties

Terms other designs use that are derived queries (src/sim/properties/derived.ts) or belong to
another system.

| Term | Use instead |
| --- | --- |
| buoyant, floats | derived: `floats(world, entity)` (density below water's 1000 kg/m³) |
| flammable right now | derived: `isFlammableNow` (flammable, wetness < 0.5, not frozen) |
| breaks under a hit | derived: `breaksUnder(world, entity, type, energy)` (fragile, breakable, toughness) |
| revealed, perceivable, targetable | derived: `isRevealed` / `revealedOnly` (not hidden); reveal with `reveal` |
| hangs from | derived: `supportOf(world, entity)` (suspended + a live support) |
| actor noise multiplier | derived: `actorNoiseMultiplier(world, equipped)` (product of noiseMultiplier, 0.2–3) |
| slippery | `friction` (ice 0.05); no separate flag |
| weak wall, weakened | `breakable` with a low blunt/force `toughness` |
| movable, throwable | `pushable` / `liftable` |
| footstep surface (carpet, gravel…) | e09 acoustic surface tags; `surfaceHardness` is only the hardness grade |
| lockable, locked | the e03 doors/locks component, not a world property |
| magical, enchanted | item data (e17/e18 enchantments), not a world property |
| wood, stone (as a tag) | `material` (a preset id); never compare material ids in rules, read the property |
